summary.text: Gary A. Drinkwater, a Republican, represents House District 27 (Alton, Argyle Township, Bradford, Corinth, Hudson and Milford, Penobscot County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Milford. The House profile lists service as Ranking Member of the Labor Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 129th, 130th, 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives retired as the occupation, high school as the education, and six years in the Air National Guard.
Listed affiliations are Selectman and School Board.
It lists two children and six grandchildren.
